rule.inclusion: every tracked market with >=1 real captured order-book ladder (captures[].at + captures[].url recorded per ladder)
rule.ordering: up to 6 FINALIZED contracts carrying the exchange's own result first (real lifetime volume_fp descending), then open contracts (close_time after the newest capture) by real lifetime volume_fp descending, then ticker; the cap of 80 is a budget for the OPEN contracts, the finalized reserve is additional
rule.captureSelection: newest 12 ladders PLUS the newest ladder at or before each of 6h, 12h, 24h, 48h, 96h, 240h before the newest capture (so an older desk cut-off still has a real point-in-time ladder)
rule.quotedRule: discovered markets with status active/initialized and real quotes but no captured ladder — listed, never priceable
rule.note: Levels are integer MILLI-DOLLARS (1/1000 $, i.e. tenths of a cent — the finest grid Kalshi publishes); counts are the exchange-reported contract counts verbatim. Nothing is re-anchored or interpolated.

checks.name: every fill names a captured ladder
every fill is at or after its ladder capture (point-in-time)
checks.detail: no fill uses a ladder captured after the fill time

checks.name: every fill price is on the market grid
checks.detail: prices come from the captured ladders, which are already on-grid

checks.name: gross = sum of the captured levels, and price = gross / count
checks.detail: arithmetic identity (levels sum + bounded VWAP rounding)

checks.name: fees equal the official formula with the CAPTURED multiplier
checks.detail: taker = round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1-P)) per level; maker = round up(M x 0.0175 x ...) only where the series carries maker fees

checks.name: slippage is measured against the best real price, not assumed
taker fills never exceed the real levels they name
checks.detail: the sum of the consumed captured levels equals the fill

checks.name: maker fills name a later real quote that crosses them
checks.detail: no maker fill without a captured crossing quote

checks.name: settlements use the exchange result and its own value
checks.detail: 0 settlement(s) carry result, value and settlement_ts

checks.name: no settlement fee is charged (official schedule)
every order is stamped with a strategy and a real timestamp
equity change = realized + unrealized - fees (residual < $0.01)
